title: MCV3 Authorization Matrix Specification v1
description: Schema validation cho authorization-matrix.yaml files. Dat tai: .mc-data/docs/phase3-architecture/auth-matrix/<system>.yaml. Su dung boi probe P-QD10-auth-matrix-check de xac minh code co role guard dung cho moi action trong tung module.

matrix_id.description: ID duy nhat cua authorization matrix (kebab-case, e.g. auth-erp-v1)

description.description: Mo ta ngan ve muc dich cua authorization matrix nay

system_id.description: System identifier (optional, e.g. ERP, MC, WEB)

roles.description: Dinh nghia tat ca cac roles trong he thong (optional — dung cho documentation)

modules.description: Danh sach module va cac actions voi phan quyen tuong ung

description.description: Mo ta vai tro trong he thong

inherits.description: Roles ma role nay ke thua quyen (e.g. admin inherits [manager])

module_id.description: Module ID tu req-registry.json (e.g. MOD-CRM, MOD-QUOTATION)

actions.description: Danh sach actions va phan quyen cho tung action trong module

roles_allowed.description: Danh sach roles duoc phep thuc hien action nay. Neu muon allow tat ca roles dung ['*'].

roles_forbidden.description: Danh sach roles TUONG MINH bi cam (ngay ca khi role co inherits vao allowed role)

guard_hint.description: Goi y ve guard implementation (e.g. 'NestJS @Roles decorator', 'Django permission_required')

public.description: true = action nay khong can authentication (e.g. login, health-check). Probe se SKIP kiem tra guard.
